Class H3RasterBinningCoordinator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.H3RasterBinningCoordinator
public final class H3RasterBinningCoordinator extends Object
High-performance deterministic spatial binning coordinator transferring spherical rasters onto discrete H3 hexagonal meshes via parallel area-weighted quadrature.
Version:
1.0.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
